_comment: Hand-labelled (subject, expected) pairs for the preference anchor resolver `harness/anchors.py` (#296). Built only from the synthetic profiles in eval/profiles/ (never personal/). `subject` is the thing the user's `phrasing` is about, as a host would extract it; `expected` is what the user means, labelled by hand, never copied from the resolver: an item key, or one of ambiguous | pending | document | multiple. `add` overlays items the profile lacks (a second role with one title, a longer name that contains a shorter one). `candidates` lists the keys an ambiguous row must name. `note` records why a label is debatable, or why a row is expected to be a miss. Categories are explained in README.md.
